prior_summary: Stationary hinge-canonical Cartesian diffusion: reconstruct the closed-lid installation frame from lid pose minus observed hinge angle, predict absolute TCP targets in that frame, and learn a weighted two-channel open/close mode.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when lid_pose and lid_position are coherent and the lid assembly may be rigidly displaced or reoriented, including release and retreat where a stationary installation reference is useful. The transformed trajectory must remain reachable and collision-free.
termination_guidance: Terminate only from physical observations: open fingers, TCP clear of the handle and panel, lid_position stably above closed with low lid_velocity, and unchanged peg_pose. Learned mode scores or caller release angle alone are not completion evidence.
limitations: The demonstrations do not include displaced installations or recovery from missed/lost contact. Root reconstruction is sensitive to disagreement between lid pose, angle and axis. Absolute root-frame targets may not correct unusual TCP entries; transformed targets may be blocked, unreachable or produce IK failure. Weighted mode learning does not guarantee release timing.

config.action_frame: freshly reconstructed stationary closed-lid hinge root
config.gripper_representation: two learned scores decoded by argmax
